title: Maternal care, connected.
subtitle: Presented by Winny Darlen
sentences: VITALINK. Maternal care, connected.
Presented by Winny Darlen for Health Hackathon three point zero.
This research prototype uses synthetic records.

title: Assessment, even offline.
subtitle: Airplane mode enabled
sentences: We start on the native Android app with airplane mode enabled.
The health worker records a synthetic patient identifier and gestational age.
Assessment and local safety rules remain available without connectivity.

title: Clinical warnings come first.
subtitle: Deterministic rules run on device
sentences: At one hundred sixty over ninety, the on-device rules request urgent clinical assessment.
Severe systolic or diastolic pressure is sufficient. Concerning symptoms also remain urgent with normal blood pressure.
Follow local escalation procedures now. Do not wait for synchronization.

title: A durable, traceable handoff.
subtitle: Pending sync means delivery is unconfirmed
sentences: The assessment is saved as an immutable encrypted snapshot, linked to one stable referral identifier.
Pending sync means delivery is unconfirmed.
The offline summary supports established telephone or in-person handoff procedures.

title: Committed records survive restart.
subtitle: Assessment, referral and outbox persist together
sentences: We restart the app.
The committed referral and its pending status remain available.
Encrypted local storage and a transactional outbox support durable recovery.

title: Connectivity returns.
subtitle: Server receipt is a separate confirmed state
sentences: Connectivity is restored. The authorized health-worker session can synchronize the pending referral.
The backend confirms receipt using the same identifier.
The app still shows that a clinician has not acknowledged it.

title: The receiving clinician can review.
subtitle: Real API, PostgreSQL and facility-scoped workspace
sentences: The doctor workspace retrieves that same referral from the real API and PostgreSQL database.
It shows the stored observations, versioned rule triggers and status history within the authorized facility.
No predictive risk score is invented.

title: Explicit acknowledgment closes the loop.
subtitle: Clinician action, actor and timestamp
sentences: The clinician explicitly confirms acknowledgment in the doctor workspace.
The server records the actor and timestamp.
Refreshing Android brings that confirmed acknowledgment back to the original referral.
This records coordination. Patient care and outcomes require separate clinical follow-up.

title: Privacy and engineering evidence.
subtitle: 70 JVM tests + 20 Android instrumentation tests
sentences: Clinical payloads use Android Keystore-backed encryption.
The latest Android release passed seventy JVM tests and twenty emulator instrumentation tests, with separate migration, restart and recovery checks.

title: VITALINK
subtitle: Winny Darlen
sentences: The current release is rules only. No validated predictive model, diagnosis or medication advice is provided.
Clinical review and field validation remain future work.
VITALINK. Presented by Winny Darlen.
